title: Features
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
Features

Automatic billing determines the amount to be paid, based on the meter reading taken for the register. Calculation rules defined in
variants in the rate are used to calculate this amount. Nonmeasured consumption and demand values specified in the facts for the

rate, the rate category or the installation are also taken into account.

Activities
For more information, see:

e Billing Execution

e Simulation/Billing Simulation

e Simulation Execution

e Billing Simulation
